title: The polynomiality conjecture for $S_{k,j}(n)$
statement:
Let $t:=n(n+1)$ and define

$$
Q_j(n):=\prod_{q=1}^{j-1}(jn+q).
$$

**Polynomiality conjecture.** For the indicated integers $k$ and $j$, $S_{k,j}(n)$ is expressed as a polynomial in

$$
Q_j(n)\mathbb{Q}[t].
$$

This claim is suggested by the explicit formulas computed in the paper, but the source gives no proof or resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.05387

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2016).
source_name: Andrei K. Svinin, “Conjectures involving a generalization of the sums of powers of integers”, arXiv:1610.05387 (2017).
